Title: SH 199
Text:
In 2025 SH 199 has freeway sections mixed in with non-freeway sections. A three-mile section between Lake Worth and Azle was upgraded to freeway standards and opened in 2018.

In 2020 work began on the Lake Worth bridge. The westbound bridge main lanes opened on May 8, 2025.

There are long-term plans to build the main lanes between the Lake Worth crossing and I-820. TxDOT held a public meeting in November 2024 showing two options, one with SH 199 at-grade with overpasses and one with SH 199 below grade. As of 2025 the project is not funded and not scheduled for construction.
